title: Claude Code enables pro website builds with UI UX Pro Max #claudecode #uiuxpromax #webdevelopment
description:
Use the UI UX Pro Max skill and 21st.dev MCP server to enable the creation of professional, animated websites with advanced design features. By installing these components, users gain access to an extensive database of UI styles, color palettes, and font pairings that support sophisticated animations, glassmorphism, gradients, and high-quality layouts.

This setup harnesses the power of Claude Code's AI combined with curated design resources from GitHub and 21st.dev, streamlining the web development process for visually appealing and modern websites. The approach reflects a growing trend in no-code and AI-assisted design tools that elevate user experience and reduce the need for manual coding.

The enhanced design capabilities hold significant value for developers, designers, and businesses seeking quicker turnarounds without compromising the aesthetic or functional quality of digital products.
